definition.word: every post, reposts left out, that holds one word of 4 letters or more
definition.word in a month: the same, within one calendar month
definition.zone in a month: every post of one zone of the map within one calendar month
definition.kept: selections of 16 to 5000 posts that the check can read: at least 4 actors with 4 posts each
